items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Jabbo Smith only in the context of listing musicians from the Jenkins Orphanage ('Jabberwocky, he came from there... That's about all I remember'), without describing a personal interaction or professional collaboration.

ctx.x: I think I made that with Louis Armstrong. I don't know, but I made it with somebody.
Did you know, what is his name, Jabbo? Javeral (?)?
Jabbo Smith? Oh, boy. What a man.
